<!doctype html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Butter-Fly | Satış Sayfası</title>
<meta name="description" content="Butter-Fly 5 L ev tipi tereyağı ve yayık ayran makinesi">
<style>
:root {
  --ink:#12283d;
  --cream:#f6efe3;
  --surface:#fffdf8;
  --blue:#0c5ff4;
  --green:#00a84f;
  --gold:#b87a18;
  --line:#e5dac9;
}
* { box-sizing:border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior:smooth; background:#f3eee5; }
body {
  margin:0;
  background:#f3eee5;
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:Inter,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;
}
.page {
  width:min(100%,850px);
  margin:0 auto;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 0 44px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
}
.section {
  position:relative;
  width:100%;
  scroll-margin-top:8px;
}
.section > img {
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  height:auto;
  pointer-events:none;
  user-select:none;
  -webkit-user-drag:none;
}

/* Invisible click areas: NO hover box, NO mobile tap highlight */
.tap-target {
  position:absolute;
  z-index:10;
  display:block;
  border:0;
  padding:0;
  margin:0;
  background:transparent;
  outline:none !important;
  box-shadow:none !important;
  text-decoration:none;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
  -webkit-touch-callout:none;
  touch-action:manipulation;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.tap-target:hover,
.tap-target:active,
.tap-target:focus,
.tap-target:focus-visible {
  background:transparent !important;
  outline:none !important;
  box-shadow:none !important;
}

/* HERO NAV – tight hit areas matching only the actual words */
.nav-neden { left:21.8%; top:3.0%; width:10.7%; height:5.0%; }
.nav-nasil { left:35.0%; top:3.0%; width:8.2%; height:5.0%; }
.nav-ozellikler { left:45.2%; top:3.0%; width:7.6%; height:5.0%; }
.nav-sss { left:54.7%; top:3.0%; width:11.5%; height:5.0%; }

/* HERO PAYMENT CTAs */
.pay-top-iyzico { left:4.0%; top:76.5%; width:24.4%; height:12.5%; }
.pay-top-cod { left:29.0%; top:76.5%; width:24.2%; height:12.5%; }

/* FINAL PAYMENT CTAs – coordinates relative to final slice */
.pay-bottom-iyzico { left:43.2%; top:17.2%; width:24.0%; height:20.5%; }
.pay-bottom-cod { left:69.1%; top:17.2%; width:23.9%; height:20.5%; }

/* Official FAQ */
.faq-section {
  padding:34px 34px 40px;
  background:#fffaf2;
  border-top:1px solid #eadfcf;
  scroll-margin-top:8px;
}
.faq-kicker {
  margin-bottom:6px;
  color:var(--gold);
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.faq-section h2 {
  margin:0 0 20px;
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  font-size:34px;
  line-height:1.05;
}
.faq-list { display:grid; gap:10px; }
.faq-item {
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:16px;
  background:#fff;
}
.faq-item summary {
  position:relative;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:16px;
  padding:17px 18px;
  list-style:none;
  color:var(--ink);
  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:800;
  cursor:pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; }
.faq-item summary::after {
  content:"+";
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:28px;
  height:28px;
  flex:0 0 28px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#f4ecdf;
  color:#9d6b16;
  font-size:20px;
  line-height:1;
  transition:transform .18s ease;
}
.faq-item[open] summary::after { transform:rotate(45deg); }
.faq-answer {
  padding:0 18px 18px;
  color:#5e676d;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.58;
}
.faq-answer p { margin:0 0 10px; }
.faq-answer p:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }

/* CSS-only modal fallback: works even if JS is disabled in a file viewer */
.order-modal {
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:1000;
  display:none;
  place-items:center;
  padding:18px;
  background:rgba(12,25,35,.60);
  backdrop-filter:blur(9px);
}
.order-modal:target { display:grid; }
.modal-card {
  width:min(96vw,680px);
  max-height:92vh;
  overflow:auto;
  border:1px solid #ead8bb;
  border-radius:28px;
  background:rgba(255,253,248,.99);
  box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
}
.modal-head {
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:16px;
  padding:24px 24px 16px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #eee4d5;
}
.modal-kicker {
  margin-bottom:6px;
  color:var(--gold);
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.07em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.modal-head h2 {
  margin:0;
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  font-size:36px;
  line-height:1.03;
}
.modal-head p {
  margin:8px 0 0;
  color:#667077;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.45;
}
.close-modal {
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:42px;
  height:42px;
  flex:0 0 42px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#f1e8db;
  color:var(--ink);
  text-decoration:none;
  font-size:25px;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.order-form { padding:22px 24px 26px; }
.product-pill {
  margin-bottom:18px;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border:1px solid #e9d6b5;
  border-radius:15px;
  background:#f4ebdc;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:800;
}
.form-grid {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:14px;
}
.field {
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:7px;
}
.field.full { grid-column:1/-1; }
.field label { font-size:13px; font-weight:800; }
.field input,
.field textarea,
.field select {
  width:100%;
  padding:13px 14px;
  border:1px solid #d9d2c7;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:#fff;
  color:#183043;
  font:inherit;
  outline:none;
}
.field input:focus,
.field textarea:focus,
.field select:focus {
  border-color:#c89c49;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(200,156,73,.12);
}
.field textarea { min-height:96px; resize:vertical; }
.flow-note {
  margin:16px 0;
  padding:13px 14px;
  border:1px solid #e4d8c5;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:#f3eee4;
  color:#53616c;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.5;
}
.submit-btn {
  width:100%;
  min-height:56px;
  border:0;
  border-radius:16px;
  color:#fff;
  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:900;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.submit-btn.iyzico {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0c5ff4,#0849cb);
}
.submit-btn.cod {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00a84f,#008b41);
}
.success-panel {
  display:none;
  padding:28px 24px;
  text-align:center;
}
.success-panel.show { display:block; }
.success-panel h3 {
  margin:0 0 8px;
  font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  font-size:32px;
}
.success-panel p {
  margin:0;
  color:#647077;
  line-height:1.5;
}
.toast {
  position:fixed;
  left:50%;
  bottom:24px;
  z-index:1200;
  max-width:92vw;
  padding:13px 17px;
  border-radius:13px;
  background:#162c3d;
  color:#fff;
  opacity:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  transform:translate(-50%,20px);
  transition:.18s ease;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:800;
  text-align:center;
}
.toast.show { opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,0); }
.toast.success { background:#08783b; }
.toast.error { background:#8c2631; }

@media (max-width:600px) {
  .page { box-shadow:none; }
  .faq-section { padding:28px 18px 32px; }
  .faq-section h2 { font-size:29px; }
  .faq-item summary { padding:15px; font-size:14px; }
  .faq-answer { padding:0 15px 15px; }
  .modal-card { border-radius:23px; }
  .modal-head { padding:20px 18px 14px; }
  .modal-head h2 { font-size:29px; }
  .order-form { padding:18px; }
  .form-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .field.full { grid-column:auto; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="close-modal"></div>

<main class="page" id="top">

  <section class="section" id="hero">
    <img src="data:image/webp;base64,
